user.title: Bosch EasyControl (Pointt API)
user.description: Paste a refresh token (get one by running pointt_login.py -- see the repo README). The device is discovered automatically.

error.invalid_auth: Refresh token was rejected -- run pointt_login.py again to get a fresh one.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Bosch Pointt API. Check your network connection.
error.no_gateways: No gateways found on this account.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

get_resource.name: Get resource
get_resource.description: Read one raw Pointt API resource and return the full response (value, writeable, allowed values, ...). For debugging and API exploration.

path.name: Path
path.description: Resource path below /gateways/{id}/resource/, e.g. zones/zn1/userMode. A directory path such as zones/zn1 may list its children.

put_resource.name: Put resource
put_resource.description: Write a raw value to one Pointt API resource. Advanced: this bypasses all entity logic and writes straight to your thermostat.

value.name: Value
value.description: Number or string, exactly as the API expects it (booleans are the strings "true"/"false").
